policy_presence.summary: Johns Hopkins distributes AI policy governance across IT responsible-use and data governance rules, Teaching @ JHU and CTEI guidance, Whiting Engineering for Professionals (EP) course color categorizations, and graduate misconduct procedures.

coursework.summary: Whiting Engineering for Professionals (EP) implements a mandatory course-level color classification: Red (no AI permitted), Yellow (moderate AI permitted with restrictions and required disclosure), and Green (liberal AI permitted with transparency). This policy applies strictly to EP courses and does not establish blanket university permission.

exams.summary: In Engineering for Professionals (EP) courses, assessments designated Red strictly prohibit generative AI assistance in any form. Tool access does not grant assessment permission, and unauthorized AI use is subject to disciplinary procedures.

ai_disclosure.summary: In Yellow and Green EP courses, students must adhere to instructor standards regarding AI disclosure, with transcripts, model citations, and visual highlighting serving as potential examples; students must save interaction records if requested. Hopkins Press requires authors to disclose AI tool use in submissions and will not credit AI as an author.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Johns Hopkins IT policies prohibit entering non-public proprietary Hopkins data (clinical, financial, and business records) into unapproved third-party AI tools. Meeting hosts should not enable Zoom AI Companion features for meetings involving student education records (FERPA recommendation). HopGPT is approved for sensitive data (PHI and PII) under institutional stewardship with required IRB/SIP approvals.

academic_integrity.summary: Under Graduate Academic Misconduct Procedures applying to KSAS and WSE (Homewood 2017 / AAP 2018), informal resolution of first offenses requires AIO consultation, sanction no greater than course failure, and mutual agreement reported to the AIO. Hearing Panels apply the preponderance-of-the-evidence standard. Except for informal resolutions, appeals must be submitted in writing to the AIO or designee for the Cognizant Dean within 10 university business days of the date of the outcome notice, limited to material procedural error, new unavailable information, or excessive sanction. Appeals involve a file review. CTEI detector guidance is instructional advice rather than a university-wide detector ban.

approved_tools.summary: Johns Hopkins provides ChatGPT Edu ($8.50/mo base plus usage for full-time faculty/staff), HopGPT (secure internal LLM), Copilot Web (free, non-HIPAA), Microsoft 365 Copilot ($215/yr, HIPAA-compliant), Claude ($22/$55 recharge for active affiliates 18+ on campus or VPN), and Zoom AI Companion (hosts should not enable for FERPA student records). Tool access does not confer coursework or exam authorization.

named_ai_services.summary: Johns Hopkins provides ChatGPT Edu ($8.50/mo base plus usage for full-time faculty/staff), HopGPT (secure internal LLM), Copilot Web (free, non-HIPAA), Microsoft 365 Copilot ($215/yr, HIPAA-compliant), Claude ($22/$55 recharge for active affiliates 18+ on campus or VPN), and Zoom AI Companion (hosts should not enable for FERPA student records). Tool access does not confer coursework or exam authorization.

teaching_guidance.summary: Teaching @ JHU and CTEI provide recommendations for faculty on instructional uses of generative AI, divisional policy consultation, accessibility considerations, and cautious evaluation of AI detection software.

research_guidance.summary: Hopkins Press requires authors to disclose generative AI use and prohibits AI authorship or substantially AI-written manuscripts. Research use of HopGPT requires IRB approval for non-clinical research and SIP approval for clinical research or uses involving PHI/PII.

security_procurement.summary: Johns Hopkins IT enforces strict prohibitions against sharing non-public proprietary Hopkins data with unapproved third-party AI tools. Approved enterprise tools include HopGPT (with IRB/SIP compliance) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (HIPAA-compliant).
